snippet.title: Tiny Kitchen: Sandwich Edition - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into your own tiny deli where building the perfect sandwich is a physics playground! Click buttons to drop ingredients like fluffy bread, sliding cheese, and bouncy lettuce. It's all about simple, satisfying, and slightly silly fun. Perfect for a quick gaming session or playing in the background.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853380/Tiny_Kitchen_Sandwich_Edition/
